supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The 12 frozen records are secondary, uneven, truncated or scraper-heavy; several are post-war items that supply only retrospective context.
The frozen set conflicts on the opening date and does not independently substantiate many detailed Draft actions, motives, casualty totals or outcomes.
All five E2 transactions and multiple E4–E7 relations use participant IDs inconsistent with their own descriptions; they provide no runtime authority or resource flow.
Coalition, state, armed-force and militia labels aggregate changing internal actors across fifteen years without member-level choices or stable preferences.
Civilian and refugee cohorts are passive context; the simulation contains no victim behavior, casualties, displacement or humanitarian outcome mechanism.
Military actions are qualified public records only; there is no tactic, force, weapon, territory, supply, finance, battle or occupation-effect model.
Taif mediation, faction positions, enforcement and post-war statuses are records, not verified agreement formation, constitutional implementation, disarmament or peace effectiveness.
The complete Draft was exposed and compressed to logical time; no external reconciliation, calibration, Reference or held-out comparison is performed.
